description: Set up free Engagemii AI-crawler monitoring for a site, entirely from here. It provisions the owner's free account and tracker key and returns a small install snippet (Node/Express, Next.js, PHP, or Cloudflare Worker) with the key already in it. Once the snippet for the site's stack is installed, AI-bot visits start reporting, and the owner sees them per bot and per day at the dashboard link. Requires the owner's email. Terms of the free service: Engagemii licenses the AI-crawler activity data the tracker collects, in aggregated form and, unless the owner opts out in portal settings, identified by their domain. The tracker records bot visits only, never human visitors.

platform.description: The site's stack, if known. Omit to get all four snippets.
